STRONGEST_SOURCE_FINDING: current Fold7ContinuityCoordinator visualMirrorActive is mirrorRequested && state==COVER_VISUAL, so visual ownership can be reported active before any host exists or any exact attempt has presentation proof. DisplayMirrorHost can then wait/fail at session, topology, host construction/attach, source bind, mirror acquisition, or geometry stages while demand remains active. SECOND SOURCE FINDING: Fold7PresentationLease is allocated per DisplayMirrorHost, so hostEpoch and attemptSequence restart on every reconstructed host; a FROZEN_VIEW attempt with the same serviceEpoch/closeCycleId/contentLeaseId can therefore reproduce the same nominal identity tuple across distinct hosts. Current host-local invalidation prevents claiming demonstrated cross-host corruption, but the identity is not globally unique enough to be the Gen3 service-level presentation owner or durable causal key. GEN3 CONTRACT: place one service-stable PresentationOwner beneath the accepted CoverVisualLease. Identity should carry serviceEpoch + cycle/movement + transitionGeneration + visualAttemptId + hostLeaseId + contentLeaseId + presentationAttemptSequence + renderPath. Allocate hostLeaseId and presentationAttemptSequence outside DisplayMirrorHost. Demand/REQUESTED is not PRESENTED. FrameCommit and TransactionCommitted are nonterminal evidence. API35 TransactionCompleted is PRESENTED_CALLBACK evidence; a valid present fence upgrades timestamp quality to PRESENT_FENCE. Stale callbacks remain loggable but inert. FROZEN VIEW REQUIREMENT: registerFrameCommitCallback alone must not prove physical visibility. Prototype a draw-synchronized SurfaceControl transaction completion tied to the current host/root; if device validation cannot establish that primitive, keep physical presentation unconfirmed and use explicit degraded policy rather than relabeling frame commit. VALIDATION: source-faithful/adversarial Kotlin model PASS=13/13 plus deterministic 100,000-event stream. It reproduces demand-without-presentation and cross-host identity collision, then validates service-stable host IDs, stale remap/reversal fencing, evidence strengths, and exact-attempt replacement. FINAL RECONCILIATION: primary Alpha1 checkpoint already accepts unified exact visual ownership, shader host, host-remap demand preservation, and stale-host rejection. display-rd terminal handoff explicitly reconciled to service-stable hostLeaseId + global visualAttemptId after reading this workstream; performance-rd terminal budget explicitly excludes presentation-owner correctness. No competing design found. INTEGRATION WARNING: do not simply expose legacy PanelEngine while presentation is pending; Fold7CoverRenderPolicy still grants privileged Gen2 cover ownership. Integrate pending/presented semantics with P0.2 CoverVisualLease/compositor. No threshold changes, no temporal-proximity inference, no synchronous fence waits, and no production GitHub writes were made. DEVICE_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=YES; MANUAL_PRIMARY_REVIEW_REQUIRED=YES.
